# Large files — linked, not copied

These are too large to copy into the case folder; they live in the local mirror. Listed here so the case folder is complete by reference.

## Oversized auto-generated outputs (Hs)
- `Current-Repo/Hs/data/pipeline_output/DATA-GEOCHEM_manifold_paper.pdf` — ~100 MB (auto-generated geochem manifold plates).
- `Current-Repo/Hs/data/pipeline_output/DATA-GEOCHEM_polar_stack.json` — ~21 MB.
- `Current-Repo/Hs/data/pipeline_output/DATA-GEOCHEM_projections.pdf` — ~11 MB (a copy of this one **is** included in `../copies/hs/`).

## Raw source datasets (18 GB total) — `Current-Repo/DATA/Geochemistry/`
Includes (among others):
- `2022-3-RY3BRK_Ball_data.csv` (+ references PDF) — the Ball intraplate-volcanics compilation behind Hs-05.
- `2022_09-0SVW6S_Stracke_data.xlsx` — Stracke OIB/MORB.
- `2022-2-FLV19S_Tappe_data_v2024.xlsx`, `2022-2-JEPY8L_Tappe_data.xlsx` — Tappe kimberlite.
- `2021-12_SS1TYI_Woerner_data.xls`.
- `2023-003_Kemnitz-Lausitz-Data-Description.pdf` (+ Datenbeschreibung).
- `1987 - Volcanism in Hawaii - Chapter 2.pdf`.

These are the raw data; the analysis documents and results derived from them are copied into `../copies/`.
